propositions: A live `none` child must be neutral in scope inheritance—contributing no paths and not poisoning sibling declarations—distinct from undeclared children which poison whole-container inheritance.
Mixed-scope signatures (paths and none children) must sign only path-child dependencies and survive unrelated file drift, but become stale when a declared child path changes.
All live children declared `none` promote an undeclared parent to signed scope `none`, while explicit parent `none` and parent-owned paths take dependency precedence and are never demoted.

Cheap resign in `resign.py` must preserve identical child-derived signed scope using the immutable relation snapshot without network reads, treating missing or inconsistent snapshot state as structured refusal.
P9 must pass declared-none leaves and containers with all-declared live children, advising only live undeclared children and naming both path declaration and `--none` as truthful remedies.
